Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 

TAPER MALE STUD COUPLING BODY FOR 

OIL-HYDRAULIC COUPLINGS 



1. Scope —Specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for taper male stud coupl- 
ing body for use in oil-hydraulic systems. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 



TABLE 1 DIMENSIONS FOR TAPER MALE STUD COUPLING BODY

^Tolerance on s : h 13. 



3. Material — Steel according to Designation 14Mn1S14 given in Schedule III of IS : 1570-1961 
' Schedules for wrought steels for general engineering purposes ' or any other steel as agreed to 
between the user and the manufacturer. 

4. Surface Protection — Coupling bodies are to be phosphated according to Class A2 of IS: 
3618-1966' Specification for phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection against corros.on ' 
unless otherwise agreed to between the user and the manufacturer. 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 These coupling bodies are intended for assembly in accordanre with T,j:e A'^JS"^" - <» 
'Specification for straight coupling assemblies for oil-hydraulic -y<- terns

5.2 For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to IS: 8805 (Part I) -1978 
General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic systems: Part I General \ 

6. Designation —A taper male stud coupling body of light series L for outside diameter of tube 
4 mm and conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 

Coupling Body L4 IS : 9392 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 



In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from DIN 3900 
Non-soldered taper-bush type pipe unions; double ended union with taper thread on screwed-in 
end used as an adaptor.
